name: Chaos Game
desc: The chaos game plays itself out in glowing vertex-hued dust — a jumping point accretes a Sierpinski gasket that morphs through carpet, pentaflake, Vicsek and a restricted-square fractal as it slowly rotates, rendered as spectral dust, ember, ice, molten gold, or dark sumi ink on paper.

energy.doc: exposure/glow + point count (first numeric — blazes at max)

scale.doc: fractal zoom (second numeric — fills/overspills frame at max)

density.doc: chaos points accreted per frame (sparse dust -> dense solid)

gamma.doc: tone-map gamma (low=hard core, high=lifts faint tendrils)

system.doc: fractal rule — auto morphs it on K.section
